scrub_pattern.description: The scrub method/pattern to use. Valid values: nnsa, dod, bsi, gutmann, schneier, pfitzner7, pfitzner33, usarmy, fillzero, fillff, random, random2, old, fastold. For custom, set to 'custom' and use scrub_custom_pattern.

scrub_blocksize.description: Blocksize for read/write calls. Can be suffixed with K, M, or G.

scrub_target.description: The special file, device, or regular file to scrub.

scrub_remove.description: Remove the file after scrubbing (if regular file).

scrub_force.description: Scrub even if target contains signature indicating it has already been scrubbed.

scrub_device_size.description: Override device size in bytes. Suffixes K, M, G allowed. Leave empty to use OS detection.

scrub_no_link.description: If target is a symbolic link, do not scrub the link target.

scrub_no_hwrand.description: Don't use a hardware random number generator.

scrub_no_threads.description: Don't generate random data in parallel with I/O.

scrub_dry_run.description: Do everything but write to targets.

scrub_freespace.description: Enable -X freespace mode. Creates files in scrub_freespace_dir until FS is full.

scrub_freespace_dir.description: Directory for freespace mode. Must exist.

scrub_file_size.description: Size of each file in freespace mode. Suffixes K, M, G allowed.

scrub_dirent_newname.description: Rename target to this name after scrubbing. Only for single target.

scrub_custom_pattern.description: Custom pattern string for custom mode. Must contain C-style escapes.
